vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (SYS-07 landing zone; CTES subservice organization)
tier_rationale: Hosts the records application, traceability database, historian replicas, customer portal, EDI gateway, and backups; supports BP-09 to BP-11 and BP-16
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Data center colocation providers in some regions carved out
exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services used
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must manage identities, keys, network rules, logging, backups, and restore testing. Mapped to AC-2, SC-12, SC-7, AU-2, CP-9, CP-4. Company gaps: CP-4 restore tests for the traceability database and EDI gateway (POAM-010)
availability_vs_bia: Service commitments support the BIA when the company configures multi-zone deployment and backups (done); recovery depends on company restore testing
incident_notification_terms: Provider notifies affected customers of security incidents per its service terms; no contractual hour count
follow_up: Confirm the carved-out colocation providers do not host the two approved regions

tier_rationale: Orders, inventory, shipping, and billing for both plants; supports BP-10, BP-14 to BP-16; integrates with the MES and traceability database
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity) plus bridge letter
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled vendor staff accounts removed late; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and removal, role design, interface monitoring, and reconciliation of interfaced data. Mapped to AC-2, AC-6, SI-10. Company gaps: quarterly reviews (POAM-001); ERP-to-portal reconciliation (P09 PI1.3)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour; BIA needs 12 hours for BP-10: meets BIA
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 48 hours of confirming a security incident affecting customer data
follow_up: Obtain the hosting provider report; add processing reconciliation to CUEC tracking

tier_rationale: Receiving, picking, and shipping at both plants; lot and pallet data for labels; supports BP-10 and BP-12
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User access, scanner device management, and data entry review. Mapped to AC-2, AC-19. No open company gaps for this vendor
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour; BIA needs 12 hours for BP-10: meets BIA

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-12 operator)
tier_rationale: Security logs and EDR agents on all IT endpoints; privileged response actions; supports detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
subservice_organizations: SIEM SaaS platform carved out (the MSSP relies on the platform provider's SOC 2)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 1 of 40 samples; management response: staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must keep escalation contacts current, approve containment, define log sources, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Company gaps: OT log sources and portal logs not onboarded (POAM-006; P09 CC7.2)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP's own continuity plan covers its operations center
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; breach of company data notified within 72 hours
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; add OT monitoring to the statement of work

tier_rationale: Temperature monitoring and alerting for the cold storage CCPs at both plants; supports BP-01 and BP-06 (MTD 2 hours)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) or an equivalent independent assessment
report_type_and_period: None available: vendor says a SOC 2 Type 2 is planned for 2027; provided a completed security questionnaire and a penetration test summary dated 2026-02
subservice_organizations: Unknown (vendor states a public cloud host)
exceptions_noted: Questionnaire: no MFA for vendor support staff on the customer dashboard; vendor administrators can edit customer alert rules
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must manage dashboard users, alert recipients, and escalation, and keep a manual log procedure. Mapped to AC-2, SI-4, CP-2. Company gaps: Plant 2 single alert recipient (POAM-019)
availability_vs_bia: No stated recovery objectives; BIA needs RTO 1 hour for monitoring: **cannot confirm**; the manual log is the real control
follow_up: Contract amendment: security schedule, 72-hour incident notice, change notice for alert logic, availability commitment; obtain the SOC 2 when issued (POAM-015)
reviewer_and_date: GRC Analyst and Director of Supply Chain and Logistics, 2026-08-25

tier_rationale: Carries all EDI purchase orders, advance ship notices, and invoices; supports BP-10 and BP-16 and the CTES
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Not known until the report is received
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Expected: partner setup approval, certificate management for AS2. To be mapped to SC-8, IA-5
availability_vs_bia: Unknown until the report is received
follow_up: Obtain the report before the observation period starts; it is a carve-out subservice organization in the CTES system description

tier_rationale: Sign-in and MFA for all workforce accounts, the cloud console, and the records application
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must configure MFA, conditional access, and lifecycle, and protect administrator accounts. Mapped to IA-2(1), AC-2, AC-6(5). Company gaps: privileged access management for administrators (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Stated availability 99.9% monthly; outage risk accepted with break-glass plan (R-042)
follow_up: Break-glass accounts for the records application and ERP

tier_rationale: Edge servers on Plant 1 Lines 5-7 with vendor remote access; product images leave the plant for model training; affects the foreign material step
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 or equivalent; on-site review of remote access and model change process
report_type_and_period: None available; vendor provided a questionnaire only
exceptions_noted: Questionnaire: model updates pushed without customer notice; remote support tool always on
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must approve model updates as OT changes, run seeded-defect tests, and route vendor access through the gateway. Mapped to CM-3, MA-4, SA-9. Company gaps: POAM-021
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery dependency: AI-001 can be bypassed; x-ray and metal detection remain the CCP
follow_up: Contract terms by 2026-11-30 (P10 conditions); vendor access through the gateway
reviewer_and_date: GRC Analyst and Plant 1 FSQA Manager, 2026-08-27

tier_rationale: Remote and on-site support for SCADA, the MES, and PLCs; holds engineering credentials
assurance_required: Annual security questionnaire and on-site review of credential handling and laptop hygiene (no SOC 2 is typical for integrators)
exceptions_noted: Integrator laptops not managed by EDR; shared engineering credentials among 4 integrator staff
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Integrator must use named gateway accounts and company-approved engineering laptops. Mapped to AC-17, MA-4, IA-2. Company gaps: per-session enablement (POAM-004); named accounts (POAM-002)
follow_up: Security schedule in the contract by 2026-12-31; named credentials for each integrator technician
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Controls Engineering Manager, 2026-08-19

tier_rationale: Employee personal information for about 850 employees; supports BP-17
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 if available (it is) and a security questionnaire every 2 years
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider and payment processor carved out
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must manage administrator access and data exports. Mapped to AC-6, AC-3. Company gap: payroll exports emailed (R-034)
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 5 days (meets the Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) 10-day duty)
